findings.evidence: All four claims are supported by the public source and reproduced accurately in the technical owner. However, the failure-recovery binding uses a typographic apostrophe where the source uses ASCII and labels the passage “Request-Reply” although it appears under “Asynchronous Callback.”
findings.required_remediation: Use the ASCII apostrophe in the binding quote and change its section to “Asynchronous Callback” for exact provenance.
